notes:
v4.6.51 — Live allocation that tracks performance + sell-down when you lower it

✨ Allocation now reflects performance
• Tools → IBKR shows each bot's LIVE allocation next to its target — its current sub-portfolio value and its share of the total (e.g. 'now $200,000 · 18%'). As a bot makes money its share grows automatically; as it loses, it shrinks. Winners are never auto-trimmed — they're free to compound.

✨ Lowering a bot's allocation makes it sell down
• When you LOWER a bot's allocation % in Tools and save, that bot is told to sell holdings (largest positions first) and hand the freed cash back to the main account — down to the new target. It only sells the excess; raising or leaving an allocation never forces a sale.
• Works for bots running locally and on the cloud (the running bot performs the sell-down on its next cycle).

Verified on the server: a bot lowered from 10% to 5% sold ~$50k back to the main account and now trades its $50k slice.

Update normally via the in-app banner.
